statement: The official death toll from the 2026-07-28 Kyushu earthquake exceeds 50 as reported on 2026-08-14.
resolution: Resolved from Japan Fire and Disaster Management Agency or Cabinet Office figures on 2026-08-14. Yes if the confirmed dead exceed 50.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite closes below 23,000 on 2026-08-28.
resolution: Resolved from the official Nasdaq closing value on 2026-08-28. Yes if the close is below 23,000.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle below 80.00 US dollars per barrel on 2026-08-28.
resolution: Resolved from the official ICE settlement for the front-month Brent contract on 2026-08-28. Yes if that settlement is below 80.00.

statement: The upper bound of the US federal funds target range is above 3.75 percent on 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the FOMC implementation note in effect on 2026-10-30. Yes if the upper bound exceeds 3.75 percent.

statement: The United States and Iran announce a signed written agreement or framework between 2026-07-29 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: Resolved yes if both governments confirm a written agreement or framework, or two or more of AP, Reuters and AFP report one as signed, by 2026-09-15.

statement: At least one additional attack on a commercial vessel in the Red Sea or the Gulf is claimed by or attributed to Houthi forces between 2026-07-29 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: Resolved from UKMTO or IMB incident reporting, or concurrent reporting by two major wires, as of 2026-09-15.

statement: A US healthcare or medical-billing breach affecting more than 5,000,000 individuals is posted to the HHS breach portal between 2026-07-29 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the HHS Office for Civil Rights breach portal on 2026-10-30. Yes if any entry inside the window reports over 5,000,000 individuals affected.

statement: The Federal Communications Commission takes no formal action to revoke or deny renewal of an ABC-affiliated broadcast license on or before 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from the FCC daily digest and EDOCS on 2026-11-30. Yes if no revocation or renewal denial affecting an ABC affiliate has been adopted.

statement: At least one person is charged in connection with either shooting near the United States consulate in Toronto, on or before 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from Toronto Police Service releases or concurrent reporting by two major wires as of 2026-10-30. Yes if any charge has been laid for either incident.

statement: EFFIS reports more than 100,000 hectares burned in France for calendar year 2026, as published on or before 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from the EFFIS annual burnt-area statistics for France read on 2026-11-30. Yes if the cumulative figure exceeds 100,000 hectares.
